data: What is the highest precision value marked on the y axis of any plot in figure 2?

The y-axis represents percentages ranging from 0 to 60%. The highest precision values marked on the y-axis are approximately 50% for both SP 10 and SP 20 lines. Therefore, the highest precision value marked on the y-axis of any plot in figure 2 is around 50%.
